build_connector_cpu_offload: build a SimpleCPUOffloadConnector instance with scheduler or worker role for CPU KV cache offloading
register_kv_caches_worker: register GPU KV cache tensors on the worker handler for CPU offload transfers
build_connector_meta_scheduler: build connector metadata from scheduler output for CPU offload request scheduling
get_finished_worker: get finished request IDs from pending CPU offload transfers on the worker side
request_finished_scheduler: handle request completion and free offloaded KV cache blocks on the scheduler side
